items.title: US attorney general dodges questions about Nvidia investigation
items.description: Nvidia's share price have fallen 7% as lawmakers demand answers about President Donald Trump's involvement in Huang's reinstatement.

items.title: French ex-President Sarkozy and wife Carla Bruni to face trial
items.description: It is the latest case involving Nicolas Sarkozy who became the first French ex-president to go to jail last year.

items.title: Indian government has 'lost the plot', says 'cockroach' leader barred from UK flight
items.description: Saurav Das says immigration authorities at Delhi airport told him his passport had been flagged.

items.title: Huawei found guilty of stealing trade secrets but acquitted of racketeering
items.description: The verdict follows a months-long trial in New York.

items.title: Land mine casualties soar in Syria, two years after war
items.description: Nearly 1,000 children are among those killed or injured by explosives left over from the conflict, figures show.

items.title: Nigerian monarch, 92, suspended after sexual assault claims
items.description: The Emir of Daura is one of Nigeria's best-known monarchs, with politicians often trying to gain his support.

items.title: Israeli air strike kills Hamas internal security chief in Gaza
items.description: Naeem Abu Nahel, who had been in the post for two months, is among seven Palestinians reportedly killed in Israeli strikes on Tuesday.

items.title: Nato chief vows defence against space threat after Russian nuclear satellite reports
items.description: German media said Russia planned to launch a satellite with a nuclear warhead into space in coming weeks.

items.title: What Jensen Huang's return teaches China's Xi about Trump
items.description: Huang being back at the helm of Nvidia is no guarantee of relief for Beijing.

items.title: Pope Francis' diary reveals claims he saw the devil three times
items.description: Published extracts from the late pontiff's diary claim one of the visions happened "in the choir loft" during Mass.

items.title: Gisèle Pelicot 'humiliated' after nude photos sent to media to promote book
items.description: The publisher of an essay on coercive control apologises for "an unfortunate and inappropriate communication".

items.title: Zimbabwean convicted in South Africa of trying to fight in Ukraine
items.description: Hundreds of people from different African countries have been recruited to fight for Russia, according to Ukraine.
